title: What's new: Governance & Administration (2024 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Linking Business Central to Power Platform environments

features.name: Environment transfer between tenants
features.description: Self-service capability to transfer Business Central environments from one Microsoft Entra tenant to another, useful for tenant consolidation, mergers, acquisitions, and demo environment handovers. Users can specify destination tenant ID and schedule transfers up to 14 days in advance.
caveats: Only internal administrators can execute transfers
Requests must be accepted within 8 hours
Users must be recreated in destination tenant
Permissions must be reassigned
Destination tenant must have paid license and available quota

features.name: Deleted environment recovery period extension
features.description: Recovery period for deleted Business Central environments doubled from 7 to 14 days, providing additional time and flexibility to recover from accidental deletions. Total backup retention remains 28 days.
caveats: Total backup time remains 28 days

features.name: Dynamics 365 Business Central administrator role
features.description: New dedicated role providing all permissions needed to administer and manage Business Central environments including lifecycle operations, extension management, and admin center access. Does not provide access to other Dynamics 365 products.
caveats: Global administrator and Dynamics 365 administrator roles will remain supported but help desk admin access will be removed
Additional roles may be needed for Power Platform support

features.name: Environment-level partner access controls
features.description: Enables restriction of partner access and administration rights to specific environments, allowing multiple partners to work for the same customer on different geographical environments without access to environments outside their scope. Access restriction applies to delegated users and service authentication apps.
caveats: Restricts both access and ability to view, modify, and delete environments
Applies to delegated users and service authentication apps

features.name: AppSource preview app installations
features.description: Allows app publishers to provide preview versions of AppSource apps for installation in sandbox environments using a special URL with preview key parameter. Preview apps can be updated to higher preview versions or public versions.
caveats: Preview apps can only be installed on sandbox environments
Sandbox with preview apps cannot be copied or restored to production
Preview apps are automatically updated with Business Central releases depending on environment configuration

features.name: Business Central and Power Platform environment linking
features.description: Links Business Central environments to Power Platform managed environments in a one-to-one relationship to inherit selected data governance settings and provide default target for integrations. Linking can be reverted; unlinking disables inherited settings but preserves deployed integrations.
caveats: Environment type and Azure geo must match
Environment cannot be deleted while linked
Copied or restored environments do not inherit the link
Linking triggers environment restart

features.name: Customer lockbox for Business Central
features.description: Enterprise policy enabling customers to review, approve, or reject Microsoft access to customer data in Business Central for support and troubleshooting operations. Enabled from Power Platform admin center and generates lockbox requests for customer approval.
caveats: Only enforced for managed environments
Requires Microsoft 365 and Power Platform licensing
Approved access is valid for 8 hours before expiring

features.name: Customer managed encryption keys
features.description: Allows customers to manage their own encryption keys for Business Central data instead of using Microsoft-managed keys. Requires creating encryption key in Azure Key Vault, creating enterprise policy, and applying it via Power Platform admin center.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is a heads up that this will be coming later in this wave
caveats: Requires linked Power Platform managed environment
Requires Microsoft 365 and Power Platform licensing
Can only be administered by global administrators, Dynamics 365 administrators, and Power Platform administrators

features.name: Auditing in Microsoft Purview
features.description: Unified audit log capability in Microsoft Purview to track create, update, and delete events requiring administrator privileges in Business Central. Includes environment administration operations, extension configuration changes, and user administration. Default 180-day retention, extendable to 10 years with licenses.
caveats: Initial release covers only administrator privilege operations
Default 180-day retention
Included with Microsoft 365 license

quotes.text: very important transfers can only be executed by internal administrators this is for security reasons
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the security constraint that limits environment transfers to internal administrators to ensure authorization.

quotes.text: we allow you to schedule these transfers up to 14 days in the future
quotes.why_it_matters: Specifies the maximum advance scheduling window for environment transfers.

quotes.text: recently we have improved it and doubled the recovery period from 7 to 14 days
quotes.why_it_matters: Announces the change in deleted environment recovery window, providing customers with more time to recover from accidental deletions.

quotes.text: the linking of environments is one to one one business Central environment to one Power Platform environment and it can also be reverted
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the one-to-one linking constraint and clarifies that linking is reversible.

quotes.text: the lockbox policy is only enforced for environments that are activated for managed environments
quotes.why_it_matters: Specifies the prerequisite that customer lockbox only applies to managed environments.

quotes.text: this is a heads up that this will be coming later in this wave
quotes.why_it_matters: Announces that customer managed encryption keys feature is not yet available but planned for later in the wave.

quotes.text: by default uh there's an 180 days log retention in perview and it can be extended up to 10 years with additional add-on licenses
quotes.why_it_matters: Specifies the audit log retention periods and licensing implications.
